'If you control a Hyper Driver, this costs {r} less to play. Boost' -- Boost is a printed keyword and fires from the card DB, deliberately not authored.

THE COST REDUCTION IS A COST, NOT AN EFFECT, so it lives in the card-level `cost_modifiers` that play.py consults when deciding what is legal and what it costs; written as an ON_PLAY effect it would apply after the price had already been paid. CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE takes `token` (singular) -- the plural spelling is unread and the condition would be false in every state. hyper_driver is an ITEM token (token_meta.ITEM_TOKENS), so it sits in the items zone that the condition scans.
